reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles and I don't buy supplements unless my doctor says so. The lab report is nice, but it doesn't change that I have no reason to add another one.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month is a lot of packaging waste, and I can't tell I'd even need magnesium. It's $30 I'd rather keep.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me I'm low on magnesium and should take it, and a regular bottle version that costs a lot less per month.
